# Canopy Tent 3D Configurator — Full System Specification

> Complete technical documentation for the interactive 3D and 2D canopy tent configurator.

## Overview
This application is a modular, schema-driven 3D product configurator inspired by MVP Visuals commercial canopy tents. It solves the core engineering challenges of interactive 3D commerce by unifying real-time 2D graphic editing with WebGL canvas rendering, dynamic pricing microservices, and automated production PDF generation.

## URLs & Routing
- Production Origin: `https://canopy-config.vercel.app/`
- `/` — Standalone full-featured configurator view.
- `/embed` — Isolated, headerless configurator view configured for secure cross-origin iframe embedding.
- `/shopify-preview` — Mock Shopify product detail page (PDP) demonstrating parent-to-iframe communication via `window.postMessage`.

## Product Variants & Pricing
- `tent-5x5`: 5' x 5' Compact Tent ($429.00 base)
- `tent-6.5x6.5`: 6.5' x 6.5' Mid-Size Tent ($499.00 base)
- `tent-8x8`: 8' x 8' Commercial Tent ($549.00 base)

## Hardware Tiers & Add-ons
- Standard Steel Frame (Included)
- Commercial 40mm Hex Aluminum Frame (+$90.00)
- Heavy Sandbag Weights Set of 4 (+$45.00)
- Heavy-Duty Roller Carry Bag (+$55.00)

## Printable Zones & UV Texture Atlas
The model features 8 independently customizable print zones:
1. `front_peak` (Rotation: 0°)
2. `front_valance` (Rotation: 0°)
3. `right_peak` (Rotation: -90°)
4. `right_valance` (Rotation: -90°)
5. `back_peak` (Rotation: 180°)
6. `back_valance` (Rotation: 180°)
7. `left_peak` (Rotation: 90°)
8. `left_valance` (Rotation: 90°)

All 8 zones are dynamically composited onto a single 2048x2048 master canvas. Changes to text, colors, or uploaded logos are rendered to the master texture and uploaded to the GPU via `THREE.CanvasTexture` throttled to `requestAnimationFrame`.

## Shopify Handoff Protocol
When adding to cart, the configurator transmits a structured payload to the host parent window:
```json
{
  "type": "SHOPIFY_ADD_TO_CART",
  "payload": {
    "items": [
      {
        "id": 48192019482012,
        "quantity": 1,
        "properties": {
          "_config_id": "...",
          "_pdf_summary_url": "...",
          "_render_preview": "...",
          "Size": "8' x 8' Custom Tent",
          "Frame": "Commercial 40mm Hex Aluminum",
          "Fabric Color": "Navy Blue (#1E3A8A)",
          "Custom Print Locations": "Front Peak (1 section)",
          "Accessories": "Sandbag Weights (Set of 4)"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```
